_notes.transform_convention: T_A_B is a 4x4 row-major matrix mapping points in frame B into frame A (p_A = T_A_B @ p_B), same as calib/rig_calib.json.

T_ee_cam_wrist.why_key_not_renamed: 'ee' is the URDF link Gripper_Base_v1_1 (the ee_link / wrist_mount_link in rig_calib.json). Key kept because desk_core/calib_store.py, scripts/recover_scene_to_base.py and scripts/verify_calib.py read 'T_ee_cam_wrist'.

T_base_board.why_key_not_renamed: 'base' is the URDF link base_link. Key kept to match the T_<parent>_<child> short names used across the scripts.

non_urdf_frames.wrist_camera_optical_frame: Not in elrobot_follower.urdf. OpenCV optical convention: +X right, +Y down, +Z forward out of the lens. Suggested name if added to the URDF as a fixed child of Gripper_Base_v1_1.
non_urdf_frames.calib_board: Not in the URDF. Origin at the board inner corner whose outer square is dark; +X along the inner columns, +Y along the inner rows, +Z into the table.

_notes.joint_mapping: q_rad[j] = joint_signs[j] * (ticks[j] - joint_zero_ticks[j]) * 2*pi/4096 for URDF joints rev_motor_01..07 (keys '1'..'7'). The transforms are only valid with this mapping.

method: bundle adjustment over all views, zeros from station viewer range-to-URDF-limit mapping
